scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --env development
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply remo-db --local --env development
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply remo-db --remote --env production
scripts.db:post-deploy:remote: wrangler d1 execute remo-db --remote --env production --file scripts/post-deploy.sql --yes
scripts.deploy:production: npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --env production && npm run db:post-deploy:remote
